contentHistory.title: Vibecoding starts — a personal subscription, not a company.
contentHistory.summary: Before there was a company, there was a Claude Code subscription and a lot of late nights. Dr. Non started natural language coding at the end of 2024 — buying personal accounts for Claude Code and Tachibiki, teaching himself what Instagram and TikTok posts described as the new way software gets built. Google AI, T-Gravity, Codex — anything that appeared in a feed got tested. Nobody asked him to do this. That is the relevant detail.
contentHistory.proofNote: Personal subscription receipts. Session logs. The early dashboards are still online.

contentHistory.source: Ministry of Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science
contentHistory.title: Dr. Poon converts a hobby into a funded operation — 700,000 THB.
contentHistory.summary: In March 2026, Dr. Non met with Dr. Poon, whose research unit operates under Thailand's Ministry of Higher Education, Research, Innovation and Science. The meeting was not about starting a company. By the end of it, a company had been started. Dr. Poon arranged 500,000 THB from the ministry's research fund. A second colleague of Dr. Non contributed 200,000 THB. Total starting capital: 700,000 THB. The only project on the table at that moment: the CDP Data Platform.
contentHistory.proofNote: Research fund allocation records. Initial project contract. The CDP Data Platform is live.

contentHistory.title: One project becomes many — TKC through EDA in a matter of weeks.
contentHistory.summary: The first fund arrived in March. By the second quarter, the pipeline had moved faster than the calendar. What started as a single CDP Data Platform project expanded through TKC, then through a succession of institutional clients all the way to EDA. Each engagement confirmed the same thesis: government agencies and research institutions needed data surfaces, and Axiom could build them faster and cheaper than any alternative they had considered. PRAM 9 and more are now in the lead stage.
contentHistory.proofNote: Project contracts. Delivery records. Active pipeline with nine confirmed leads.

contentHistory.title: AIBP retreat in April — the room that changed the deal flow.
contentHistory.summary: The AIBP retreat in April 2026 was the moment the investor network opened. The room was full of people who move capital. They saw what Axiom was doing. Since that meeting, leads have been arriving through that network — not cold outreach, but introductions from people who were in the room. The pipeline did not just grow after April. The quality of the pipeline changed.
contentHistory.proofNote: AIBP event records. Post-retreat introductions traceable in deal history.

contentHistory.title: 700,000 THB in. 10,000,000 THB projected by December 2026.
contentHistory.summary: The starting capital was 700,000 THB. The year-end revenue projection, read from the current pipeline and confirmed deal flow, is 10,000,000 THB. The math is in the nine active leads — each one closes at a fraction of that figure, and not all of them need to close for the number to hold. That is not optimism. It is what the pipeline says, read conservatively.
contentHistory.proofNote: Pipeline valuations. Active deal negotiations. Conservative close-rate assumptions applied.
